features.title: Search threads and workspace files
features.summary: Search top-level threads by title, project, and id prefix; subagents and child sessions are excluded. Rank recent threads by title, project, and id prefix; rank workspace paths by basename and frecency; the Threads tab lists the current project’s threads (its thread workspaces included) unless threadsScope is all.

configuration.constraints: One of project or all; without a current project the Threads tab lists every thread.

failureModes: A thread title or project match is omitted from results.
A child session or subagent appears in the Threads list.
A file basename match is buried below unrelated path matches.
A persisted user message does not return from thread-content search.

verification.testName: thread search matches title, project, and id prefix
thread search excludes children and subagents but keeps top-level sessions
empty thread search returns the most recent candidates
file search prefers basename matches and lifts frecent paths
empty file search lists frecent paths before walk order
lists only the current project on Threads and every project on Everything

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Search threads and workspace files renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Register and invoke typed palette actions
features.summary: Expose namespaced, validated actions to the shared palette, notify subscribers on changes, and dispose registrations cleanly.
failureModes: A duplicate or unnamespaced action id enters the registry.
A disposed action remains visible or callable.

verification.testName: registrations publish actions, notify subscribers, and dispose cleanly
duplicate and un-namespaced action IDs are rejected
palette mode and recent limit share the browser registry across API calls
actions match labels and aliases, preserve ties, and use frecency

telemetry.reason: Browser-only action registry: actions are registered and run in the client, so no Host work exists to trace.

features.title: Rank recently used actions and files
features.summary: Persist bounded, per-browser action and file usage counts so recent use improves ranking without overriding a better text match.
failureModes: Recent use fails to affect result ordering.
Usage storage grows beyond its configured bound.

verification.testName: recording a use counts it and refreshes its time
recent use outweighs an old habit until the habit is much stronger
storage stays bounded and drops the weakest entries
empty file search lists frecent paths before walk order

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Rank recently used actions and files renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Ask DSH from an empty palette
features.summary: Tab on an empty command palette opens an ask bar; the question becomes a fresh thread's first message, titled Ask DSH · <question>, and that thread opens in the main view.
reach: fill combobox "Search the command palette" "how do I rebind a shortcut?"
click option "Ask DSH: how do I rebind a shortcut?"
expect text "Ask DSH · how do I rebind a shortcut?"
failureModes: Tab on an empty palette does not open the ask bar.
The question never becomes the new thread's first message.
A failed send closes the palette and loses the question.

verification.testName: creates one fresh session, sends the trimmed question, then opens the thread
keeps the current project so the ask thread is grouped with its siblings
refuses an empty question before creating a session
does not open a thread when the Host refuses the question
opens on Tab from an empty search and returns to search on Escape

keeps the question and explains a failed send
entering Ask DSH clears the query and Escape leaves it before closing the palette
sends the question on Enter once a row is active
prefixes the question so asks group in the sidebar
keeps only the first line and bounds the title

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Ask DSH from an empty palette renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.
